lastCompletedStory.title: Best-effort patterns archive on the --cycle-close path

nextStoryContext: US-003 wired dispatchJournal's --cycle-close branch (index.ts) to auto-invoke a new patternsArchiveFn dep on JournalDispatchDeps, defaulting to the already-existing defaultPatternsArchiveFn (the 'cam patterns archive' dispatcher's own production default, reused via function-declaration hoisting -- see the CAM-226 patterns.md bullet). Ordering: journal archiveFn best-effort check -> patternsArchiveFn best-effort check -> armMarker() -> CAM_ORCH_HANDOFF_DUE; both archive checks are wrapped in their own try/catch and only printWarning on failure, never change dispatchJournal's exit code. Tests live in test/commands/patterns-cli.test.ts (new describe block 'dispatchJournal --cycle-close auto-invokes patternsArchiveFn (US-003)'), not journal-append.test.ts, since the story's oracle pinned that file. US-004 (retrofit 2026-06 build-notes markers + document marking convention) needs: (1) the exact RESOLVED_MARKER_RE regex from src/commands/patterns-archive.ts (/\[resolved \d{4}-\d{2}\]/, exported) to retrofit `[resolved 2026-06]` markers onto already-resolved bullets dated 2026-06 in scripts/cam/patterns.md, and (2) a short documented marking convention (a preamble line in patterns.md or a CLAUDE.md note) so future contributors/agents know how to hand-mark a bullet resolved. Read patterns.md in full for US-004 (it is the retrofit target) rather than grepping a subsection.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Pure CLI-dispatch wiring in index.ts (best-effort side-effect call ordering, injectable deps, printWarning) inside the pre-existing dispatchJournal function; no external library surface was exercised or changed.
